title: Lenovo reports Q1 revenue up 43% YoY to $26.94B, its highest quarterly revenue growth in five years, as AI-related revenue rose 60% YoY to $9.3B, 35% of total (Laurie Chen/Reuters)
summary: Laurie Chen / Reuters: Lenovo reports Q1 revenue up 43% YoY to $26.94B, its highest quarterly revenue growth in five years, as AI-related revenue rose 60% YoY to $9.3B, 35% of total — China's Lenovo Group (0992.HK) reported a 43% jump in quarterly revenue on Thursday, beating forecasts and sending shares …
